fields.summary_ko.0: Saudi Arabia PIF holds 80.2% of SpaceX (SPCX) U.S. equity portfolio: 154M shares worth $23.25B, representing a dominant allocation within the total $28.99B portfolio as of September 30.
fields.summary_ko.1: Following completion of the $55B Electronic Arts acquisition, PIF's holding increased from 70% to 80%, though SpaceX per-share value declined from $170.86 to $150.86.
